up.note:
LP duality / von Neumann over (deterministic algorithms) $\times$ (inputs). Works because
expected cost is linear in the algorithm's distribution -- this is why the minimax theorem
is naturally about $\bar{\mathrm{R}}$ and not $\mathrm{R}$. The payoff matrix never refers
to the output being unique, so the theorem is about relations.
